Chicken Adobo

Family recipe, written down for the first time here because everyone keeps asking and I'm tired of texting it one line at a time.

Serves 4

Ingredients:
2 lbs chicken thighs, bone in
1/2 cup soy sauce
1/2 cup white vinegar
1 head garlic, cloves smashed
3 bay leaves
1 tsp whole black peppercorns
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 cup water

Method:
Combine everything except the water in a pot or bag and let the chicken marinate for at least 1 hour, longer if you have the time, even overnight is fine.

Transfer the chicken and marinade to a pot, add the water, and bring to a boil.

Reduce to a simmer and cover. Cook time: 45 minutes, until the chicken is fork tender.

Uncover for the last part of that time so the sauce reduces and thickens.

Serve over rice with the sauce spooned generously on top.

Note: don't skip the marinating step, it does more for the flavor than the actual cooking does.
